summary: 27-year-old woman from Golden severely injured when her car went off Bear Lake Road, rolled over and came to rest in Glacier Creek; extricated by rangers and Estes Park fire/dive team, airlifted to Medical Center of the Rockies; not wearing a seatbelt
responding_agency: RMNP rangers, Estes Park volunteer fire/dive team
